description: Generated from the scrim settings registry by `scrim config schema`. Do not edit.

token.description: Reference to the bearer token operators present on a TCP admin listener (admin.url http://host:port). Required for TCP; the Unix socket uses peer credentials instead. scrim approve and friends send it.

url.description: Address of the scrim admin API for operator commands: unix:/path/to/socket or http(s)://host:port. Empty means unix:$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/scrim/admin.sock.

permissions.description: Permission bits of the API socket, octal. Widen (for example 0660) only to let agents running as other local users connect; their identity still comes from peer credentials.

socket.description: Unix socket of the local agent API. Empty uses $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/scrim/api.sock.

listen.description: TCP address that serves only the decision-link endpoint, for approvals.public-url to point at (usually through a TLS reverse proxy). Empty means decision links are served on the admin listener only.

poll-interval.description: How often a waiting operation re-reads its approval from the state backend; bounds how long a decision recorded elsewhere takes to release it.

public-url.description: Base URL under which the decision endpoint is reachable from approvers' devices, for example https://scrim.example.org. Empty means notifiers get no decision links and approvals are decided with scrim approve.

signing-key.description: Reference to the key (at least 32 bytes) that signs decision links, shared by every replica. Empty means a random key per process: links stop working on restart and on other replicas.

timeout.description: How long an approval waits for a decision before it is denied. A rule's approval.timeout overrides it.

entries.description: Catalog entries by logical name: ref, profiles, variants, prefix, template, hosts, placeholder, class, inject, tools. References only, never values.

environment.description: Catalog environment that selects per-environment references.

files.description: Catalog files to load, in order. Each is a YAML document with `kind: Catalog` and an `entries` map. Reloaded when they change.

metadata-from.description: Store prefixes (for example bao://kv/agents) whose secrets' metadata labels are read as catalog entries.

metadata-prefix.description: Prefix of the store metadata keys read as catalog bindings: <prefix>hosts, <prefix>placeholder, <prefix>profiles, <prefix>name, <prefix>class, <prefix>field.

profile.description: Catalog profile (for example dev or prod) that selects per-profile references.

reload-interval.description: How often catalog files are checked for changes.

strict.description: Reject config files containing keys scrim does not know. When false, unknown keys are reported as warnings instead.

watch.description: Reload the configuration when a config file or an included file changes. SIGHUP always triggers a reload.

memory-lock.description: Lock the data plane's memory so values are never swapped: auto locks when the memlock limit is unlimited and warns otherwise; require refuses to start without it.

path.description: Path of a scrim-dataplane binary to run instead of the embedded one. For development builds; release builds embed it.

push-debounce.description: How long the control plane waits after a store, catalog, configuration or policy change before it pushes a new snapshot, so bursts of changes become one push.

restart-max-backoff.description: Longest wait between data plane restarts after repeated crashes.

start-timeout.description: How long the data plane may take to start and answer the handshake.

listen.description: Loopback address of the page where a human enters a value for secret_ask_human. Port 0 picks a free port.

default-ttl.description: Grant duration when neither the rule nor the approver chooses one.

max-ttl.description: Longest grant any rule or approver can create. A rule's grant.max_ttl can only lower it.

agents.description: Agents by service account: agent name to space-separated selectors sa:NAMESPACE/NAME (globs allowed), scope:SCOPE, label:K=V. A service account no rule maps is the agent NAMESPACE/NAME, or unknown with identity.kubernetes.unmapped: unknown.

api-server.description: Base URL of the Kubernetes API server for TokenReview. Empty uses the in-cluster address (KUBERNETES_SERVICE_HOST and KUBERNETES_SERVICE_PORT).

audience.description: Audience an agent's projected service account token must carry. Tokens for any other audience, such as a pod's default API token, are refused.

ca-file.description: CA bundle that verifies the API server.

cache-ttl.description: How long a verified token is trusted before the cluster is asked again, capped at the token's expiry. A deleted pod or service account is refused within this bound.

enabled.description: Identify in-cluster callers by projected service account tokens, verified with the TokenReview API. Pods send the token as the password of the proxy user k8s or as the value of x-scrim-session. On in the k8s profile.

token-file.description: scrim's own service account token, which authorises TokenReview calls (RBAC: create tokenreviews, for example by binding system:auth-delegator). Re-read on every call, since the kubelet rotates it.

unmapped.description: What a verified service account no identity.kubernetes.agents rule maps becomes: derive names the agent NAMESPACE/NAME, unknown treats it as an unknown caller.

peers.description: Agents by local user or group: agent name to space-separated selectors uid:N, user:NAME, gid:N, group:NAME, scope:SCOPE, label:K=V. Empty maps the user scrim runs as to one agent named after it.

store-credentials.description: Static per-agent store credentials: `<store>/<agent>` to a reference (env:, file:, cred: or a store reference) of a store token held for that agent. The fallback for agents without Kubernetes passthrough; a store listed here refuses agents that have none.

store-login.description: Per-agent store login, by store instance: `kubernetes role:<template> [mount:<path>]` logs in to the store (OpenBao Kubernetes auth) with the calling pod's own service account token at the role the template names; {namespace}, {service_account} and {agent} are replaced. A store listed here refuses agents that have no usable identity of their own.

include.description: Files, globs or directories merged after this file, relative to it.

format.description: Log record format: text (logfmt) or json, one object per line.

listen.description: Address of the metrics and health endpoint (Prometheus format at /metrics, /healthz or /livez, /readyz). Empty disables it; bind to loopback unless scraped remotely.

token.description: Reference to an ntfy access token for publishing. Empty publishes anonymously.

topic.description: ntfy topic approval requests are published to. Anyone who can read the topic sees approval metadata, so use an access-controlled topic or a long random name.

url.description: Base URL of the ntfy server, for example https://ntfy.sh. Empty disables the ntfy notifier.

enabled.description: Print each approval request with its scrim approve and scrim deny commands to the control plane's terminal.

hold.description: Longest time one submit or poll request is held open by the receiver (sent as X-Nono-Timeout-Secs, capped by the approval's remaining time).

poll-interval.description: Pause between polls when the receiver answers pending without holding.

secret.description: Reference to the shared secret (at least 32 bytes) that signs webhook requests with HMAC-SHA256. Empty sends unsigned requests.

url.description: Approval service URL for the webhook notifier (nono approval webhook v1 compatible). https, or http to a loopback host. Empty disables it.

inject.description: Built-in rule `builtin.inject-bound` for injecting a credential toward a host it is bound to, for an identified agent: allow, ask, or off (injection is then decided by your rules and policy.default). Deny rules in the rules file still win.

default.description: Decision applied when no rule matches. Anything other than deny is reported as a weakened protection.

deny-all.description: Break-glass: deny every injection, grant and approval while redaction continues. While set in configuration it cannot be released from the CLI.

deny-all-refresh.description: How often each replica re-reads the deny-all state from the state backend; the bound on how long a change on one replica takes to reach the others.

rules-file.description: Path of the policy rules file (YAML or JSON with default and rules). Empty means no rules: every request gets policy.default.

profile.description: Built-in preset of defaults for a deployment shape: `local` for a laptop or VM, `k8s` for Kubernetes, `ci` for throwaway runs. Any value a profile sets can be overridden.

dir.description: Capture mode: write every provider request exactly as it left, and the response as received, to this directory (mode 0700; refused if group or others can access it). Empty disables capture. `scrim proxy --capture DIR` sets it.

retention.description: Captured files older than this are deleted.

on-unavailable.description: When the chained upstream cannot be reached: fail refuses the request, direct sends the already redacted request to the provider and audits the skip.

url.description: Base URL of a chained upstream (for example a context compression proxy) that receives every redacted provider request in place of the provider. Empty means no chain.

forward-listen.description: TCP address of the forward proxy for agents with HTTPS_PROXY set (scrim run sets it): provider hosts go to the LLM proxy, every other host to the tool proxy with credential injection. Empty disables it; keep it on loopback.

listen.description: TCP address of the LLM proxy base URL (agents use http://<address>/anthropic and http://<address>/openai/v1). Empty disables it; keep it on loopback.

socket.description: Unix socket path for the LLM proxy base URL, for agents that can connect to one. Empty disables it.

anthropic.description: Base URL Anthropic Messages requests are forwarded to after redaction.

chatgpt.description: Base URL requests to chatgpt.com (Codex signed in with ChatGPT, through the forward proxy) are forwarded to after redaction.

chatgpt-ab.description: Base URL requests to ab.chatgpt.com (Codex signed in with ChatGPT, through the forward proxy) are forwarded to after redaction. Its API shape is not documented, so every request body is redacted as generic JSON.

openai.description: Base URL OpenAI Chat Completions and Responses requests are forwarded to after redaction.

min-value-length.description: Shortest value matched in free text; shorter values are matched only in exact and encoded forms.

placeholder-key-dir.description: Directory of the generated placeholder key, used when redaction.placeholder-keys is empty. Empty means $XDG_STATE_HOME/scrim/keys (~/.local/state/scrim/keys).

placeholder-keys.description: Placeholder keys by name, each with `version` (1 to 255) and `key` (a reference to at least 16 bytes). The highest version is current; lower ones keep resolving placeholders made before a rotation. Every replica sharing conversations needs the same keys. Empty means a key generated once and kept in redaction.placeholder-key-dir.

allow-reveal-credentials.description: Glob patterns over store references of credentials that scrim reveal may resolve locally. Empty means reveal never resolves a credential. Restore into responses never resolves credentials, whatever this holds.

allow-shell-data-commands.description: Commands a shell-role restore may pass display values to, beyond the built-in list of commands that run no code. A listed command that interprets an argument as code turns a restored value into code.

builtin-tools.description: Use the built-in table of agent tool roles (Claude Code, Codex). When false only restore.tools have roles and every other tool is unknown, which restores nothing.

display-mode.description: What the agent displays for display-class values: values resolves them in assistant text, placeholders keeps placeholders (for example while screen sharing). Tool arguments follow the tool roles either way; credentials are never restored.

tools.description: Tool aliases by name: `role` (none, read, search, shell, edit, write, network), optional `name` (the tool name exactly as the model calls it, default the instance name), `command-field` for shell, `old-fields` and `new-fields` for edit. An alias overrides the built-in table.

allow-unredacted-start.description: Start the agent anyway when scrim cannot start, its data plane is not ready or no session can be minted. The agent then reaches providers directly and unredacted; scrim run prints a warning.

mcp.description: Register scrim mcp with the agent for this session (Claude Code --mcp-config, Codex -c mcp_servers.scrim). Nothing is written to the agent's own configuration.

placeholder-env.description: Export each declared catalog placeholder that resolves for the session as an environment variable of the same name holding the placeholder, for example SCRIM_ACME_KEY=SCRIM_ACME_KEY.

max-ttl.description: Longest lifetime a session token can be minted with.

ttl.description: Default lifetime of a session token minted by scrim run. The token is revoked earlier when scrim run exits.

backend.description: State backend for approvals, grants, sessions and audit metadata. The local profile uses sqlite ($XDG_STATE_HOME/scrim/state.db); ci and k8s use memory, which writes nothing to disk (set postgres for shared state).

connect-timeout.description: How long start-up waits for PostgreSQL to answer before failing.

dsn.description: Reference to the PostgreSQL connection string (postgres://user:pass@host/db?sslmode=verify-full), for example env:SCRIM_PG_DSN or file:/run/secrets/scrim-dsn. It holds a password, so it is a reference.

max-conns.description: Maximum connections in the PostgreSQL pool.

allow-network-filesystem.description: Allows the SQLite state file on a network or shared filesystem (NFS, SMB, sshfs), where file locking is unreliable and the database can be corrupted. Use the postgres backend instead.

stores.description: Secret store instances by name. The name is the instance's reference scheme (`bao://...` for an instance named bao); `kind` picks the adapter, `aliases` adds schemes, `redact` lists references and prefixes loaded into the redaction set, `refresh.*` tunes refresh and outage handling, and every other field is the adapter's own. See docs/stores.

cert-file.description: PEM certificate of an operator-supplied interception CA, used together with tool-proxy.ca.key. An operator-supplied CA is never rotated by scrim; a warning is logged once it is within tool-proxy.ca.rotate-before of expiry.

dir.description: Directory of the generated interception CA (certificates, private keys, rotation state, trust manifest). Empty means $XDG_STATE_HOME/scrim/ca (~/.local/state/scrim/ca). Created with mode 0700.

key.description: Reference to the PKCS#8 PEM private key of the operator-supplied CA in tool-proxy.ca.cert-file (env:, file:, cred: or a store reference). Empty means scrim generates and rotates its own CA.

overlap.description: After a rotation, how long the previous CA stays trusted through a cross certificate and in the trust bundle. Capped at the previous certificate's expiry.

rotate-before.description: A generated CA is rotated when less than this much of its validity remains. For an operator-supplied CA it is how early the expiry warning starts.

validity.description: Validity of each generated CA certificate.

capture-rules.description: Response capture rules by name: `hosts`, optional `methods`, `path` glob and `status` codes select the response; exactly one of `json-pointer` and `header` selects the field; `store-ref` is the store reference the value is written to. The agent receives the reference's placeholder instead.

listen.description: TCP address of the HTTPS tool proxy (credential injection and response redaction) for tools pointed at it directly. Empty disables it.

approval-timeout.description: How long a pending approval waits for a decision before it expires as denied.

grant-default-ttl.description: Duration of a grant when secret_request names none.

grant-max-ttl.description: Longest grant secret_request can produce. Longer requests are capped and the result says so.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP collector URL for traces, for example http://127.0.0.1:4318. Empty disables export; incoming W3C trace context is still propagated.

sample-ratio.description: Fraction of new root traces sampled, 0 to 1. A sampled incoming parent is always followed.
